prompt.project_info: Create a realistic post-workout gym scene showing an approved adult woman resting face down after intense strength training.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman lying face down on a gym platform floor, wearing a dark long-sleeve athletic top, black shorts, and fingerless workout gloves. Her posture communicates physical exhaustion with determined recovery.
prompt.composition_elements: Top-down or angled view of the subject on black rubber flooring, with a barbell carrying green weight plates, a dumbbell, and a pair of glasses visible nearby.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Realistic indoor fitness-center lighting, grounded documentary mood, authentic workout fatigue, accurate equipment and flooring texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic digital photography, vertical composition, sharp equipment and clothing detail, natural perspective, realistic hands and anatomy.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a realistic photorealistic gym photograph of an approved adult woman lying face down on a gym platform after an intense strength-training session. She wears a dark long-sleeve athletic top, black shorts, and fingerless workout gloves. Place a barbell with green weight plates, a dumbbell, and a pair of glasses nearby on black rubber gym flooring. Use natural indoor fitness-center lighting, accurate equipment, realistic anatomy and fabric texture, and an exhausted-but-determined documentary mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, malformed weights
